The following stay the same in reported speech.
The doctor told me I should rest.
He claimed he used to be very rich.
He agreed that he might be wrong.
When what is being reported is still true, you can use
present and future forms in the normal way because
we are talking from the point of view of now.

Verbs often have more than one pattern.
